message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of TEMPO magazine, dated 29 November- 5 Desember 2021. Against a gradient blue background, a central figure in a white, high-collared garment and a black balaclava stares forward. The figure's hands are raised to either side of their head. Each hand holds a vertically bisected half of a different face. These two halves appear to be a single mask of an older man with a white prayer cap, brown skin, a mustache, and a goatee, which has been split down the middle. This outer mask is sliced horizontally into several segments. The interior figure behind the balaclava is only visible through a narrow eye slit. 

Transcribed text includes the red "TEMPO" masthead and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Smaller headlines read "Babak Baru Korupsi Bansos H.72" and "Depresi karena Pandemi H.68." The main headline at the bottom is "DUA WAJAH JAMAAH ISLAMIYAH" followed by three lines of smaller Indonesian text ending in "Strategi baru melebarkan sayap? H.30." A barcode and publication details occupy the upper right corner.
